queries.exists: SELECT 1 FROM programs WHERE name = 'ocenaudio' AND publisher = 'Ocenaudio Team';
queries.patched: SELECT 1 WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM programs WHERE name = 'ocenaudio' AND publisher = 'Ocenaudio Team' AND version_compare(version, '3.22.2') < 0);
queries.open: SELECT 1 WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM processes WHERE LOWER(name) = 'ocenaudio.exe');
